purpose: Threat and trust-boundary mapping for the planned RideX fresh project; this is not penetration-test evidence or a production security approval.

method.basis: System boundary, data ownership, authorization boundary, 25-edge connection register, security requirements and component source inventories.
method.defaultDeny: Unknown actor, object, role, geographic scope or ownership must fail closed.
method.authority: Backend remains authoritative for identity, bookings, fares, payment outcomes, authorization and trip state.

Admin display/actions only; Backend checks role, permission, scope and session

threats.title: Client actor/identity spoofing
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: An untrusted client changes actor IDs or object IDs to act as another user.
threats.requiredMitigations: Backend derives effective actor from validated session and checks ownership/object authorization on every protected operation.

threats.title: Admin role or geography escalation
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: STATE/CITY Admin accesses another state/city by changing URL, filters, object identifiers, export or bulk action.
threats.requiredMitigations: Enforce server-side GLOBAL/STATE/CITY scope across list/detail/create/update/delete/export/nested resources; deny unknown scope by default.

threats.title: OTP guessing, resend abuse or purpose confusion
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Repeated guessing, resend races, old OTP reuse, wrong-purpose verification or account enumeration.
threats.requiredMitigations: Purpose-bound server validation; expiry/attempt limits, resend timing/cooldown, old-code invalidation with attempts carried forward, rate limits and non-enumerating responses. Exact length/cooldown still require final decision.

threats.title: Session token theft or replay
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Token copied from weak client storage/logs and replayed before expiry/revocation.
threats.requiredMitigations: Platform-appropriate secure token storage, short/defined expiry, revocation, user/device state checks, TLS and strict log redaction. Mobile secure storage and revocation behavior need runtime evidence.

threats.title: Super Admin control/key impersonation
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: A private key or static privileged secret is embedded in a distributed app, or a control device is impersonated.
threats.requiredMitigations: Never ship a plaintext private key in the app. Define enrollment, proof-of-possession, device trust, key rotation/revocation and privileged-action confirmation; shell currently has no live authority.

threats.title: TEST/LIVE environment crossover
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: A TEST client/provider or old DB endpoint writes to LIVE resources or activates test payment logic in LIVE.
threats.requiredMitigations: Separate database identities, app IDs, API hosts and provider credentials; local-only during foundation; server enforces mode; TEST mocks/signatures rejected by LIVE providers.

threats.title: Fare/payment tampering or replay
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Client modifies fare/amount/currency/provider status or replays create/refund/webhook calls.
threats.requiredMitigations: Backend computes or validates authoritative quotes; verify provider signatures, amount/currency/order binding, idempotency and atomic ledger updates; reconcile ambiguous outcomes.

threats.title: Concurrent booking/driver acceptance race
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Two drivers accept one offer, or retries create duplicate bookings/trips.
threats.requiredMitigations: Atomic conditional state transition, database uniqueness/transaction constraints, idempotency keys and deterministic terminal state.

threats.title: Database/schema lineage or direct access failure
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: A client or wrong environment reaches business DB; conflicting baseline/legacy migrations cause wrong schema or data loss.
threats.requiredMitigations: Only Backend owns business DB; clients never connect directly. Reconcile canonical migration lineage before applying to a fresh disposable local DB; backups/restores loopback-only with explicit destructive opt-in.

threats.title: Forged/replayed provider webhook or Gateway callback
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Unauthenticated callback changes delivery/payment state or repeated ACK causes duplicate business action.
threats.requiredMitigations: Verify callback signature/authentication, nonce/request/job binding and timestamp/replay window; make ACK/result idempotent; keep Gateway unable to change business trip state directly.

threats.title: Unauthorized private file/KYC access
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Guessable object IDs/URLs or stolen signed links expose KYC or private files.
threats.requiredMitigations: Check object ownership and role/scope server-side; short-lived signed links, upload MIME/size verification, no public bucket and privacy-safe access audit.

threats.title: Sensitive-data disclosure via logs/diagnostics
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: OTP, bearer tokens, full query URLs, personal IDs, provider credentials or payment payloads are written to logs or responses.
threats.requiredMitigations: Structured allowlisted logging, field-level redaction, route-template labels, correlation IDs without secrets, tested retention and restricted access.

threats.title: Provider queue loss/duplicate execution/storage split
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Different JSON/SQLite/PostgreSQL state stores disagree; leases expire incorrectly; restart loses jobs or duplicates delivery attempts.
threats.requiredMitigations: Choose one authoritative Provider storage path; durable queue/outbox, atomic lease/claim, bounded retry, terminal/dead-letter state and reconciliation. Storage choice remains open.

threats.title: Cross-actor realtime/event leakage
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: SSE/push replay exposes another customer/driver/admin’s events or stale event replay overrides authoritative state.
threats.requiredMitigations: Authenticate subscriptions, authorize audience/server-side scope, use opaque cursor replay bounds, handle replay gaps by fetching authoritative snapshots and redact event payloads.

threats.title: Spoofed/stale GPS or incorrect Driver assignment
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Mocked/stale location or invalid city/state assignment affects matching, trip safety or service availability.
threats.requiredMitigations: Validate active state/city/serviceability on submit; enforce timestamp/freshness and anomaly checks; client coordinates are signals, not sole proof.

threats.title: Test/demo feature enabled in LIVE
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Demo subscription/insurance flow or synthetic payment result is enabled against production API.
threats.requiredMitigations: Use compile-time build profiles and backend environment/authorization gates; reject test signatures on LIVE server; release manifest fails if test-only feature is enabled.

threats.title: Dependency/supply-chain compromise
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Compromised package or stale generated artifact introduces malicious code or undisclosed behavior.
threats.requiredMitigations: Pin lockfiles, verify clean reproducible builds, run dependency/SBOM scanning, review postinstall/native scripts and do not ship stale dist/build artifacts.

threats.title: Unsafe deletion/retention of security audit data
threats.attackOrFailureScenario: Deleting OTP-purpose configuration also deletes related history/audit; security investigations lose evidence.
threats.requiredMitigations: Treat OTP-purpose deletion as explicit approved exception only; review lawful retention and forensic impact, require privileged confirmation and document remaining irrecoverability.

globalControls.control: Clients never connect directly to the business database.
Client-supplied actor identity, fare, payment outcome or trip status is not authoritative.
Super Admin private key must not be embedded in a distributed application.
Physical tests, security scans and deployment verification remain NOT RUN until all four package implementations complete.
The recorded OTP-purpose deletion/history exception requires explicit final risk review; do not generalize deletion behavior.

openReviews: OTP exact digit length, cooldown and push retry policy are not all finalized.
Canonical top-level success:boolean envelope is recorded; dynamic/idempotency replay bodies and runtime caller compatibility still need verification.
Provider authoritative storage path must be selected before job durability tests.
Canonical migration lineage must be approved before any database migration is executed.
Super Admin Control key enrollment, rotation and revocation design is incomplete.
Audit retention/deletion policy and the OTP-purpose deletion exception need authorized review.
Dependency installation and Android SDK availability are blocked in the current analysis runtime.
